sources_accessed.nature: AFI Catalog of Feature Films release synopsis
sources_accessed.findings: Synopsis confirms Buzz tells Kevin a false story about neighbor Marley murdering his family in 1958. Identifies Harry and Marv as 'the wet bandits' due to flooded sinks. Does not document the nickname 'South Bend Shovel Slayer', contains zero mention of snow globes, and does not mention Buzz's girlfriend photo.
Initial HTTP fetch returned client-rendered wrapper without article body text; subsequent MCP fetch timed out/canceled. No verifiable participant quote directly extracted during this run.

Referenced from existing repository audit (native-research.json). Contains Buzz Marley story (scene 16) and girlfriend photo scene (p.29), but no snow globe mention. Draft text does not constitute release-film proof.

q_ha1_p1_12.claim: Какое прозвище дали соседу с лопатой (старику Марли) местные дети в первом фильме? / Key: South Bend Shovel Slayer
q_ha1_p1_12.reason: Missing final-film proof. AFI synopsis verifies Buzz's murder rumor regarding Marley but omits the specific moniker 'South Bend Shovel Slayer'. While present in earlier script drafts as Buzz's rumor rather than a verified neighborhood fact, exact released-film dialogue was not directly viewed from authoritative release transcripts or video.
q_ha1_p1_12.evidence_snippet: AFI: 'Buzz tells Kevin and one of their cousins that Mr. Marley... murdered his family in 1958, but was never convicted...'

q_ha1_p1_18.claim: Какой предмет коллекционирования Марв маниакально воровал из каждого дома в первой части? / Key: Стеклянные снежные шары (Snow Globes)
q_ha1_p1_18.reason: Unsupported / unverified trivia. AFI synopsis and fourth-draft screenplay contain no reference to Marv stealing snow globes; AFI explicitly confirms the burglars' MO was leaving kitchen taps running to earn the name 'the wet bandits'. No opened primary source substantiates a snow-globe collection.
q_ha1_p1_18.evidence_snippet: AFI: 'As the thieves leave the Murphy house, Marv stops up the kitchen sink and turns on the water to flood the place...'

q_ha1_p1_20.claim: Интересный факт: кто на самом деле изображен на фотографии «девушки Базза»? / Key: Мальчик (сын арт-директора) в парике
q_ha1_p1_20.reason: Inaccessible primary proof. AFI synopsis omits the photograph gag entirely. The TIME magazine article (secondary interview citing actor Devin Ratray) was not successfully retrieved in readable text in this run. Screenplay confirms the in-scene gag but not behind-the-scenes casting trivia. Lacks direct rights-holder or primary production archive confirmation.
q_ha1_p1_20.evidence_snippet: Script draft scene 29 establishes the photo existence; behind-the-scenes casting of art director's son remains unverified by opened primary sources.
